image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a bison's head and forequarters against a snowy background. The bison has thick, dark brown shaggy fur, a prominent shoulder hump, and a visible horn curving upward. The eye is dark and visible, and the ear is partially obscured by fur. The lower jaw features a beard of long hair. One front leg is partially visible, appearing sturdy and covered in fur.

The visible eye is dark and clearly defined.
The ear is small and largely surrounded/obscured by the thick fur of the head, consistent with the taxonomy.

The transition from the neck fur to the visible front leg lacks clear anatomical definition. The leg appears to emerge somewhat ambiguously from the chest fur without a distinct joint or separation, creating a slight 'melted' appearance in the anatomy.
